inputs.modified_text: Look, this conviction of Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame in Paris, under the new law on psychological subjection is obviously the work of hidden elites coordinating to dismantle religious groups that refuse to submit to their total control system. The whole protection narrative is just a smokescreen for breaking apart independent resistance. Those ripples of concern in religious communities and among civil liberties advocates aren't any authentic pushback—they're a dead giveaway that the laws are being weaponized from above to impose real psychological subjection, with the state posing as the victim while it eradicates opposition.
